breaking.change: Removed -og-frame: rive(...) without an alias. Rive loading and playback are semantics of the reflected og-rive element, not CSS decoration.
breaking.fix: Write <og-rive src="ui/chest.riv#Chest"> and use standard CSS for its dimensions and visibility. Source IDs remain relative to assets/. Playback, hot reload, picking, dependency loading and checkpoint replay are unchanged; probe edits replace the src attribute.
